Jwt._comment: Secret is a dev-only value committed for local convenience. In any shared/production environment, override it via User Secrets, an environment variable (Jwt__Secret), or a secret manager - never commit a real signing key.

AzureBlobStorage._comment: Points at Azurite (the local Azure Storage emulator) by default so image upload works out of the box in dev. Override ConnectionString via User Secrets or an environment variable (AzureBlobStorage__ConnectionString) for a real storage account in any shared/production environment - never commit a real connection string/key.
